business_context.description: Creation of a new internal division, BMW Operating System (BWMOS), to develop a full software stack (in-vehicle OS, OTA, AI, connectivity) from scratch for model year 2028. This is a founding executive role to build a high-velocity tech culture within a legacy automotive OEM.
business_context.urgency_driver: Competitive gap with VW and Mercedes compounding; must stand up capability in 4-5 months to meet 2028 production milestones.
business_context.regulatory_description: Automotive software safety standards; data privacy/sovereignty; software-defined vehicle compliance.

constraints.hard_deadline_reason: Cycle plan for 2028 model year requires architectural freeze on OS stack.

priority_capabilities.must_have_1: Experience building and scaling high-performance software engineering organizations from near zero
priority_capabilities.must_have_2: Fluency in modern software development methodologies (CI/CD, Sprints, Product Management)
priority_capabilities.must_have_3: Ability to navigate the friction between software velocity and legacy automotive hardware cycles

key_stakeholders.sensitivity_note: Critical sponsor who must defend the new culture against legacy encroachment.
The primary point of friction: software speed vs. hardware safety/validation cycles.

classification.classification_reasoning: Explicitly describes building a new software-defined vehicle division from zero to transform the company's tech capability.

crisis_mgmt.confidence_reasoning: Explicitly defined; long timeline makes crisis skills less critical.
crisis_mgmt.business_logic: Crisis management is not the primary driver in a long-horizon build scenario.

ops_depth.business_logic: Need just enough automotive credibility to speak the language, but deep legacy ops depth might actually be a hindrance.

change_adapt.confidence_reasoning: Explicitly defined as the primary driver.
change_adapt.business_logic: The entire job is managing the friction of building a new culture inside a legacy organization.

stakeholder.business_logic: Must maintain credibility with legacy engineering leadership while disrupting their methods.

external_net.business_logic: The leader's network IS the delivery mechanism for the massive recruitment needed (40-120 people in 18 months).

floor_constraints.description: Minimum acceptable score per dimension for this scenario.

active_floors.floor_reasoning: Without a top-tier software engineering network, the hiring targets for the first 12 months are impossible.
The leader will face intense institutional resistance; they must be a master of navigating transformation friction.

floor_constraints.floor_derivation_logic: Floors are set very high for the core transformation capabilities required to stand up a new entity.

dimension_correlation_warnings.description: Flags pairs of dimensions that are structurally correlated in this scenario.

correlated_pairs.scenario_specific_note: In a legacy org, change adaptability is almost entirely about stakeholder negotiation.

scenario_intelligence.scenario_summary: Requires a founding engineering executive who can build a high-velocity software culture from scratch while successfully defending it within a legacy OEM. A pure technologist who cannot navigate corporate politics, or a pure corporate executive who doesn't understand software velocity, will both fail.

hidden_complexity_flags.description: Starting with zero headcount; extreme recruiting pressure.
hidden_complexity_flags.impact_on_analysis: External network quality is the single biggest predictor of success in the first 12 months.

hidden_complexity_flags.description: Legacy automotive engineering vs. Silicon Valley software culture.
hidden_complexity_flags.impact_on_analysis: Soft-power stakeholder management is just as important as technical vision.

candidate_archetypes_to_seek.archetype_description: Has a track record of building technical organizations from zero in complex environments.
candidate_archetypes_to_seek.why_fit_this_scenario: Understands the sequence of building a culture, not just a product.
candidate_archetypes_to_seek.typical_weakness: Can become impatient with the 'slow' parts of the organization.

candidate_archetypes_to_avoid.archetype_description: Excellent at running large, stable, process-heavy organizations.
candidate_archetypes_to_avoid.why_wrong_for_this_scenario: Will inadvertently recreate the legacy culture they were hired to disrupt.

scenario_specific_interview_themes.rationale: The team will be defined by the first 10 hires.
scenario_specific_interview_themes.suggested_question: Describe your specific playbook for hiring the first 10 engineers in a new division where the brand name is strong but the tech reputation is unproven.
